fastapi: FastAPI: the package the app and router constructors are imported from, and this pack's name
prefix: FastAPI: the path-prefix keyword on APIRouter(...) and include_router(...)
response_model: FastAPI: route-decorator keyword naming the declared response body model
status_code: FastAPI: route-decorator keyword naming the declared response status
responses: FastAPI: keyword on a route decorator, APIRouter, include_router or FastAPI listing extra responses by status
Depends: FastAPI: the callable that declares a parameter the framework resolves and passes in, rather than reads off the request
Security: FastAPI: Depends with scopes, declared the same way and injected the same way
Header: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a header, converting the parameter's underscores to hyphens
Query: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a query parameter
Path: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a path parameter
Body: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a field of the JSON body
Form: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a field of a form body
Cookie: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a cookie
alias: language: Python's grammar calls the name after `as` in an import the alias. FastAPI: the keyword on a parameter function that gives the name the request uses
headers: suss: the parameter role for a header, which the request spelling maps to the headers section
queryParams: suss: the parameter role for a query parameter
pathParams: suss: the parameter role for a path parameter
requestBody: suss: the parameter role for the request body
cookies: suss: the parameter role for a cookie
decoratedFunctionRoute: suss: PythonDiscoveryPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
braces: suss: path-template syntax name, defined in @suss/adapter-python; selects the {name} reader for FastAPI's Starlette-style paths
router: FastAPI: the include_router parameter that takes the router
methods: FastAPI: the api_route keyword listing the methods the route serves, GET when it is not passed
FastAPI: FastAPI: the app constructor, whose dependencies, middleware and exception handlers reach every route
dependencies: FastAPI: the keyword on FastAPI(...), APIRouter(...) and a route decorator that lists dependencies run before the handler
middleware: FastAPI: the app decorator that registers a function run around every request
exception_handler: FastAPI: the app decorator that registers a function run when a handler raises
dependency: suss: PyWrapperForm variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a function written in a Depends-style parameter default or dependency list
decoratedWrapper: suss: PyWrapperForm variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a function registered through a decorator attribute on the app
everyRoute: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on the app reaches every route of the pack
ownRoutes: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on a router reaches the routes decorated on that router
openapi_url: FastAPI: the app keyword that moves the OpenAPI document, /openapi.json when it is not passed, or turns it off with None
docs_url: FastAPI: the app keyword that moves the Swagger UI page, /docs when it is not passed, or turns it off with None
redoc_url: FastAPI: the app keyword that moves the ReDoc page, /redoc when it is not passed, or turns it off with None
swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_url: FastAPI: the app keyword that moves the Swagger UI's OAuth2 redirect page, /docs/oauth2-redirect when it is not passed
app: Starlette: the keyword on mount(...) that takes the app mounted at the path
StaticFiles: Starlette: the static file server, which FastAPI re-exports from fastapi.staticfiles
add_api_route: FastAPI: the app and router method that adds a route by a call, GET when it lists no methods
add_route: Starlette: the app and router method that adds a route by a call, serving the methods its endpoint class defines when it lists none
route: suss: PyServingCall variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a call that adds a route the table does not read. Starlette: the app decorator that adds a route, read the way add_route is
add_middleware: Starlette: the app method that adds a middleware class around every request
middleware_class: Starlette: the keyword on add_middleware(...) that takes the middleware class
cors: Starlette: the module starlette.middleware.cors, which FastAPI re-exports as fastapi.middleware.cors
CORSMiddleware: Starlette: the CORS middleware, which responds to a preflight OPTIONS request itself
gzip: Starlette: the module starlette.middleware.gzip, which FastAPI re-exports as fastapi.middleware.gzip
GZipMiddleware: Starlette: the middleware that compresses a response and serves nothing of its own
trustedhost: Starlette: the module starlette.middleware.trustedhost, which FastAPI re-exports as fastapi.middleware.trustedhost
TrustedHostMiddleware: Starlette: the middleware that refuses a request for another host with 400 and serves nothing of its own
httpsredirect: Starlette: the module starlette.middleware.httpsredirect, which FastAPI re-exports as fastapi.middleware.httpsredirect
HTTPSRedirectMiddleware: Starlette: the middleware that redirects a plain HTTP request to the same path over HTTPS
sessions: Starlette: the module starlette.middleware.sessions, which FastAPI re-exports as fastapi.middleware.sessions
SessionMiddleware: Starlette: the middleware that reads and writes a session cookie and serves nothing of its own
add_exception_handler: Starlette: the app method that registers a function run for an exception class or a status
exc_class_or_status_code: Starlette: the keyword on add_exception_handler(...) that takes the class or the status
exception_handlers: Starlette: the app keyword that registers exception handlers by class or status
Exception: language: Python's base class of every ordinary exception
BaseException: language: Python's root of the exception hierarchy
underPrefix: suss: PyServer paths, defined in @suss/adapter-python; says a path a call on a router states is served under a prefix the reading does not put together
errorHandler: suss: PyServingCall variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a call that registers an error handler
